title: How To Edit The Default Search Results Radius For The Site

## How To Edit The Default Search Results Radius For The Site
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682672
When a user does a search on the site for a specific location, the default is to display all members within a 50 mile (or kilometer, depending on the settings of the site) radius from the searched location. To edit this radius, please follow these steps:
